test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The list price of a washing machine is Rs. 13,200. It is sold to a retailer after two successive discounts of 25% and 15%. The retailer wants to earn a profit of 20% on his cost after allowing a 25% discount (on its new list price) to the customer. At what price should he list the washing machine?
solution:
**Given:**

List price of the washing machine = Rs. 13,200

Two successive discounts = 25% and 15%

Retailer's desired profit = 20%

Discount allowed to the customer = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Successive Discount Formula: {Effective Discount} = a + b - (a times b)/(100)

Profit Formula: {Selling Price} = {Cost Price} + {Profit}

Calculation of new list price after discount: {New List Price} = frac{{Selling Price}}{1 - {Discount}}

**Calculation:**

First Discount = 25% on Rs. 13,200

Discounted Price after first discount = 13,200 × (1 - 0.25)

⇒ Discounted Price = 13,200 × 0.75 = Rs. 9,900

Second Discount = 15% on Rs. 9,900

Discounted Price after second discount = 9,900 × (1 - 0.15)

⇒ Discounted Price = 9,900 × 0.85 = Rs. 8,415

Retailer wants to earn a profit of 20% on his cost

Cost Price = Rs. 8,415

Selling Price = 8,415 × (1 + 0.20)

⇒ Selling Price = 8,415 × 1.20 = Rs. 10,098

Retailer allows a 25% discount on the new list price

Let the new list price be P

Selling Price = P × (1 - 0.25)

⇒ 10,098 = P × 0.75

⇒ P = 10,098 / 0.75

⇒ P = 13,464

**The retailer should list the washing machine at Rs. 13,464.**
